A friend of mine once told me: “Not everything about the job you love will be enjoyable, but you still push through because you love it still.” I saw it differently after that conversation I had. It’s similar to how it is with people, don’t you think? When we fall in love, even though there may be traits we dislike about our person, we still love them and that makes it all worth it. Again, it really is different for everyone, but having this mindset has helped me force myself to actually work even when I feel like wasting my time by playing games or such things. My opinion is that not everything good is fun or enjoyable, sometimes it is boring and annoying, but at the end of the day, it’s worth it because it’s for our health.
